RHYD-1.payload: corresponds	The assertion establishes all stated properties across all three entry paths: artifacts from the git state branch (deleted from disk before the run, present only in the state branch) appear in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after resume (proving both _artifact_persist_restore and _artifact_persist_put_back were called), pipeline.resume precedes the first stage.start event (restore before dispatch loop), and intake emits no stage.start (complete stage skipped).	""

RHYD-2.payload: corresponds	The assertion sets up a state with intake=complete but no artifact on disk and no git-state-branch snapshot, runs with --resume, then checks exit code is 1 and no stage.start events were emitted — directly establishing both conditions of the requirement.	""

FSTG-1.payload: corresponds	The assertion snapshots intake-result.json, removes it, runs with --from-stage cyc, and asserts the artifact is restored with correct content, intake emits no stage.start, and cyc's cycle.start event fires as the first dispatch — establishing rehydration, correct skip, and <s> dispatched first.

FSTG-2.payload: corresponds	The assertion omits the snapshot step so no restorable artifact exists, runs with --from-stage cyc, and asserts exit code 1, stderr contains "has no restorable primary artifact", and no stage.start events — matching the requirement exactly.

AMDR-1.payload: corresponds	The assertions collectively check for all named elements (step number "3.6", "_runner_resume_rehydrate", "exit 1", "before the dispatch loop", "git state branch", "not to be combined with dispatch-loop changes", both enforcing test names) in the ADR-006 file itself; "inline" in the requirement means the test names appear in the ADR document (the standard Enforced by practice per CLAUDE.md), which the string-presence checks establish.	""

AMDR-2.payload: corresponds	The awk extracts only §6 of ADR-050 (not the whole document), then checks for "new run", "ADR-006", and "continues the same run" within that section — directly establishing that §6 carries the boundary note distinguishing resume from new-run as the requirement states.	""

ITER-1.payload: corresponds	The three sub-cases establish all parts: (1) with _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true and current_iter=1 in state, the first dispatch is iter=2 and iter-1 is not dispatched; (2) after the outer resume consumed the flag, a re-entry starts at iter=1 (nested-loop re-entry); (3) with _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE unset, a fresh run starts at iter=1 — covering all three guards the requirement names.	""

ENTR-1.payload: corresponds	For each of the three paths the assertion confirms the artifact is restored, pipeline.resume is emitted at a positive line number, and pipeline.resume precedes first stage.start, establishing that _runner_resume_rehydrate (or equivalent) ran before the dispatch loop on all three entry paths.

FRSH-1.payload: corresponds	The tagged assertions establish all three required behaviors: intake (stage 1) was dispatched (not skipped to a later stage), no stage.skip events fired, and no prior-run artifact content appears in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR — using --no-resume with prior interrupted state is a stricter scenario that, if it passes, subsumes the simpler clean-slate case.	""

BNDY-1.payload: partial	The tagged assertions verify only the fresh-run sub-case (intake dispatched, fixture contains type: cycle) but cannot assert the structural property that the file also contains resume-side RHYD-1/RHYD-2 assertions coexisting in the same file, which is what the requirement requires.	"resume-rehydrate-test.sh contains both a resume-side assertion (RHYD-1/RHYD-2) and a fresh-run sub-case with --no-resume, pinning both sides of the ADR-006/ADR-050 §6 boundary in one test file"

DLGT-1.payload: partial	The sentinel establishes that hydrate_run calls _artifact_persist_put_back, but no assertion tagged DLGT-1 establishes that the resume rehydration path also calls _artifact_persist_put_back — that half of the shared-function guarantee is left to RHYD-1 assertions in a different test file.	"Resume rehydration and the hydrate plugin both call _artifact_persist_put_back"

CYCL-1.payload: corresponds	Both files carry a CYCL-1-tagged assert_contains that checks the artifact-snapshot-coverage fixture for "type: cycle", directly establishing that both test files exercise a cyclic-pipeline fixture as the requirement states.	""
